g.text: 17 species · one subsite · exact recorded starts
Source: Baird et al. (2021), Coral Spawning Database v1. Species points show earliest recorded starts; orange extensions show additional starts.
The case was selected for coverage. Wider-record spans depend on survey effort and do not measure reproductive success.
Recorded starts span 3 hours 15 minutes. Sharing a night does not mean spawning at the same moment.
